## Classification(분류)

**`accepted(수용)`**

Codex closeout proposal(코덱스 마감 제안) is consistent with the bounded lifecycle evidence(제한 생명주기 근거). F74 tested the hypothesis(가설), ran the mandatory negative-control MT5 runtime probe(필수 부정 대조 MT5 런타임 탐침), and the outcome is weak exploration with no authority path(권위 경로 없음)—not a hidden success.

`closed_preserved_clue_negative_memory_no_authority` fits because:

- **Preserved technical facts(보존 기술 사실)** exist: raw density gate(원시 밀도 게이트) 6/6, ONNX/signal parity(온엑스/신호 동등성) 3/3, probe completion(탐침 완료) 2/2.
- **Negative research outcome(부정 연구 결과)** is clear: meaningful candidate(의미 후보) 0, scout clue(탐색 단서) 0 across F74B/F74C; runtime KPI(런타임 KPI) stays far below stated goals(목표).
- **Claim boundary(주장 경계)** is respected: no completion, baseline, promotion, runtime authority, live readiness, or Goal Achieve.
- **Next frontier pivot(다음 전선 전환)**—different upstream mechanism(다른 상류 메커니즘), not another F74 repair loop(수리 루프)—matches the evidence pattern.

No `needs_local_verification(로컬 검증 필요)` for this closeout classification itself; the snapshot is sufficient to judge label fit and claim discipline(주장 규율).

---

## One Preserved Clue(보존 단서 하나)

**Raw microburst turnover labels(원시 마이크로버스트 회전 라벨) can pass the density gate(밀도 게이트) strongly (6/6 axes, ~13–15 trades/day proxy(프록시 일거래)) while still producing zero meaningful alpha surface(의미 알파 표면 0).**  
Effect(효과): future label work(향후 라벨 작업) can separate **density feasibility(밀도 실현 가능성)** from **signal quality(신호 품질)** instead of treating density pass(밀도 통과) as seed-surface success(씨앗 표면 성공).

---

## One Negative Memory(부정 기억 하나)

**Clean/value label repair(깨끗은/가치 라벨 수리) on the same microburst stack(같은 마이크로버스트 스택) scaled candidates(후보 확대) (1296) but produced 0 scout clues(탐색 단서 0) and 0 meaningful candidates(의미 후보 0); the best materializable path(최선 물질화 경로) (`f74c_1161`) only reached weak runtime(약한 런타임): validation PF(검증 PF) ~1.16, validation DD(검증 손실폭) >10%, trades/day(일거래) ~1.6—far from 5–10 tpd(일 5~10회), PF 2–3+, DD <10%.**

---

## One Do-Not-Repeat Note(반복 금지 메모 하나)

**Do not open the next frontier(다음 전선) as another F74-style threshold/clean-label/session repair loop(임계값/클린 라벨/세션 수리 루프) on microburst turnover labels(마이크로버스트 회전 라벨).**  
If density passes(밀도 통과) but scout clue(탐색 단서) stays 0 after raw + repair(원시+수리), pivot upstream mechanism(상류 메커니즘 전환)—e.g. order-flow/volatility-compression/session-liquidity framing(오더플로/변동성 압축/세션 유동성)—before any more label-family tuning(라벨군 미세조정).

---

**Claim boundary reaffirmed(주장 경계 재확인):** this review accepts closeout labeling(마감 라벨 수용) only; it does not grant completion(완성), baseline(기준선), promotion(승격), runtime authority(런타임 권위), live readiness(실거래 준비), or Goal Achieve(목표 달성).
